inputs.text: [serious] Gorgonops. "Gorgon" is a monster from really old Greek stories — [scared] so terrifying that just looking at it was scary. [confident] And "ops," face.
[warmly] Yes — scientists found its skull genuinely fearsome. [confident] It lived in South Africa, two hundred sixty million years ago.
[confident] No, not at all — it lived way before them. [warmly] It's an even closer cousin of ours than Dimetrodon.
